title: Tughlaq Dynasty Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq
definition: Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq (reigned 1320–1325 AD) was the founder of the Tughlaq dynasty, marking the transition from the Khalji dynasty to a more centralized, agrarian-focused administration in the Delhi Sultanate.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the shift in administrative policy, agrarian reforms, and the consolidation of the Sultanate's frontiers against Mongol incursions.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tughlaq Dynasty Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Feudal structure of the Delhi Sultanate
